title: Semivan and Kit Green question Tom DeLonge in a hotel room
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Semivan and Kit Green question Tom DeLonge in a hotel room, about c. 2015 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It was Semivan and Kate Green. They got Tom Dong in a hotel room and they said like where'd you get this stuff from?

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron says on Jesse Michels' podcast that around 2015 two advisers, Jim Semivan and Kit Green, met a musician named Tom DeLonge in a hotel room in the United States. According to Cameron, they asked DeLonge where he had gotten the information he had about UFOs. He tells it as the start of how DeLonge came to work with insiders.
